     from. Business: VEGA Mexican Cuisine -->

# DESIGN.md — VEGA Mexican Cuisine

archetype: street-market
rationale: VEGA has a fixed address and a full-service dining room, so it is not a market stall. But its own line is "EAT. DRINK. FIESTA.", it runs a named party night four evenings a week plus a weekday 4–7PM happy hour, and its brand is a full-strength purple against coral. That earns the poster-wall direction: flat clashing panels and loud stacked type that make "what's on tonight" the headline. The archetype's "where are they this week" becomes "which night is it this week" at one Hartsdale address.

interaction_level: L2

personality: [loud, festive, generous, sure-footed]

typography:
  display: "Josefin Sans"
  body: "Archivo"
  scale: 1.5
  notes: |
    Josefin Sans is geometric, not condensed, so it earns its loudness through weight, case and stacking.
    - Display: always 700, uppercase, tracking −0.01em, line-height 0.9. Headlines stack in short lines of one to three words, and lines may change size within one headline (e.g. "EAT." huge, "DRINK." smaller, "FIESTA." huge again).
    - Hero display: clamp(3.5rem, 11vw, 10rem). Section heads step down at 1.5×. Item names on menu lists use Josefin 600 uppercase at 1.125rem with 0.04em tracking.
    - Prices: Archivo 700 tabular figures, set at least as large as the item name. The price is part of the argument.
    - Body: Archivo 400 at 1.0625rem, line-height 1.55. Labels and eyebrows: Archivo 600 uppercase, 0.75rem, 0.12em tracking.
    - Nothing in a script face. Nothing in a serif.

palette:
  primary: "#9e459a"
  secondary: "#ffffff"
  accent: "#e95951"
  ground: "#fcf5f9"
  surface: "#f3e4ef"
  ink: "#2a0f2b"
  muted: "#6b4a69"
  border: "#e2cadb"
  application: |
    The colours do the structural work in flat, full-strength panels, the way fly-posters overlap on a wall.
    - Primary purple: whole bands carrying white type (5.6:1, passes for body text). Used for the hero colour field, the hours band and the catering close.
    - Accent coral: flat blocks, big display type and the BOOK A TABLE button.
      - White goes on coral only at display size (3.5:1). Any small text on coral is ink (5.0:1), including the button label.
      - Coral never sits as text on purple (1.6:1, fails). Purple and coral meet only as adjoining panels, which is the deliberate clash.
    - Ink: deep plum. Used for body text (16:1 on ground) and as a third panel colour carrying white type.
    - Ground: a pale off-white tinted with the purple.
    - Surface: a pinker step from the ground, so raised areas still belong to the brand.
    - Muted: plum-grey, 6.1:1 on surface and readable in daylight.
    - Border: a pale plum-pink between ground and muted, used for hairlines.
    - Why these neutrals: every one is pulled from VEGA's purple rather than from a grey ramp, so even the quiet parts of the page are on-brand.

composition:
  whitespace: tight
  photography: supporting
  card_usage: none
  mobile: |
    - Hero: the stacked tagline holds at 3.5rem minimum and keeps its line breaks. The hero photograph moves above the type as a 4:5 crop rather than sitting behind it.
    - Weekly-nights strip: becomes a vertical stack of four full-width day panels.
    - Menu sample and hours: collapse to one column, with prices staying right-aligned on the item's baseline.
    - Gallery: becomes a free-scroll horizontal strip cropped at the right edge.
    - Sticky bar: a BOOK A TABLE bar persists on mobile only. It sits left of the accessibility widget's corner and never covers it.

pages:
  - slug: menu
    title: "Menu: Tacos, Fajitas & Happy Hour | VEGA Mexican Cuisine"
    description: "The full VEGA dinner menu in Hartsdale, NY: tacos, fajitas, enchiladas, signature plates, happy hour bites and drinks, weekly specials, desserts and coffee."
    h1: "The VEGA Menu"
    intent: |
      Answers "what can I eat and drink, and what does it cost".
      - Carries every non-catering category: the Dinner groups, Happy Hour Bites and Drinks, Dessert, Cordials and Hot Drinks, plus the four weekly night names.
      - Shows each item's price exactly where one is given and none where it is not.
      - The six "Catering …" categories belong on catering.html, not here.
    takes: [offerings]
    sources: [https://www.vegamexican.com/]
  - slug: catering
    title: "Mexican Catering in Hartsdale, NY | VEGA Mexican Cuisine"
    description: "Turn your party into a fiesta. VEGA caters sweet sixteens, weddings and corporate events across Westchester with trays of tacos, fajitas, enchiladas and more."
    h1: "Catering by VEGA"
    intent: |
      Answers "can VEGA feed my party, and how do I ask".
      - The six "Catering …" categories from the menu content, in full and unpriced.
      - "Half Tray serves 8–10 | Full Tray serves 15–18".
      - The two highlights: In-House Party Packages and Live Counter (Outdoor).
      - An inquiry form (form_type catering) with name, email, phone, event date, number of guests and event details.
    takes: []
    sources: [https://vegamexican.com/catering]
  - slug: hiring
    title: "Careers at VEGA Mexican Cuisine | Hartsdale, NY"
    description: "VEGA Mexican Cuisine in Hartsdale, NY is hiring: managers, servers, bartenders, bussers, cooks and dishwashers. Tell us about yourself and apply online today."
    h1: "We Are Hiring!"
    intent: |
      Answers "is VEGA hiring, and how do I apply".
      - The six positions: Manager, Server, Bartender, Buss Person, Cooks, Dishwasher.
      - An application form (form_type hiring) with name, email, position and message. Nothing else.
    takes: []
    sources: [https://vegamexican.com/hiring]

composition: |
  Lead with the party, not the pedigree. The four weekly nights and the 4–7PM happy hour are why someone picks VEGA tonight, so they sit right under the hero. Then comes proof that the food and the service hold up: a priced handful of dishes, three reviewers naming Manny, and a New York Times review. The calm water-feature dining room is the surprise, not the opener. Booking is always one tap away, and catering closes the page as the "bring the fiesta to you" offer.

sections:
  - id: hero
    priority: essential
    show: all
    intent: "Answer 'what is this' in three seconds: a lively Mexican dining room and cocktail bar in Hartsdale, NY, with one step, BOOK A TABLE."
    spec: |
      - Headline: "EAT. DRINK. FIESTA." stacked on three lines at mixed display sizes, in white, on a full-strength purple field.
      - Photograph: the supplied hero image (…1791809501_wau76r.webp), cropped tight and set into a coral-edged block that overlaps the purple field like a poster pasted over another.
      - Beneath the headline: one line drawn from their hero copy naming tableside guacamole and mezcal and tequila margaritas. Then "Hartsdale, NY · (914) 723-0010", with the number as a tap-to-call link.
      - Actions: one coral BOOK A TABLE button (square corners, ink text) linking to Resy. ORDER NOW appears only as a small underlined white text link to Toast.
      - Ticker: a marquee along the hero's foot reads "HAPPY HOUR MON–FRI 4PM–7PM · TACO TUESDAY · WINE WEDNESDAY · LADIES NIGHT THURSDAY · GENTLEMEN'S NIGHT MONDAY". It stops under reduced motion.
  - id: offers
    priority: essential
    show: all
    intent: "The site's distinctive moment. Make VEGA's week legible at a glance, so a visitor knows which night to come and that weekdays 4–7PM are happy hour."
    spec: |
      - Weekly nights: the four nights run in weekday order (Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday), each as its own flat panel cycling purple, coral, ink, purple. The order is real information here.
        - The day name is huge. The night's name sits beneath it: white on purple and ink panels, ink on the coral panel.
        - The nights have no descriptions in the content, so show the names only.
      - Happy hour: a separate ink band with "MONDAY – FRIDAY 4PM–7PM" at display size, then the bites and drinks lists exactly as given, including "House Margarita + Flavour 2 + Floater 5". No prices: none exist.
      - Ladies Night at VEGA: shown with its description and its date, Aug 13, 2026, and no time.
  - id: offerings
    priority: essential
    show: "6 of 202, chosen for range, links to menu.html"
    intent: "Prove the food is real and fairly priced: Street Side Guacamole 16, Avocado Fritters 10, Tacos (Birria) 22, Enchilada (Chicken Tinga Mole) 18, Carnitas 22, Churrasco 35. That spans the dishes reviewers praised, from the $10 small plate to the $35 signature."
    spec: |
      - Item names in Josefin uppercase. The price is large and shares the name's baseline, with a thick coral rule between them. The description sits beneath in body size.
      - No images and no cards.
      - Ends with a full-width purple link band, "SEE THE FULL MENU", with white type.
  - id: reviews
    priority: essential
    show: all
    intent: "Answer 'can I trust it' with real guests. Three of the five reviews name Manny, so let his name carry the proof."
    spec: |
      - Pull "Manny was the best. Come for the mojitos!" (Kayla Sexton) at display size on a coral panel, in ink.
      - Show the other four as plain text columns, with each author's name exactly as given.
      - Joy's long review may be excerpted with an ellipsis, but never reworded.
      - No star rows.
  - id: awards
    priority: supporting
    show: all
    intent: "Back the noise with credibility: The New York Times Review, Lohud Top 5 Stylish Restaurant, Best of Westchester, Restaurant Hunter. Set as type in the page's own faces, each linking to its article URL from their copy."
  - id: story
    priority: supporting
    show: all
    intent: "Reveal the other side of VEGA: founded on a love of Mexican food, music and culture, with a striking modern room built around a soothing central water feature. Ends on 'Bienvenido a VEGA!'"
  - id: gallery
    priority: supporting
    show: "7 of 8, the hero photograph not repeated"
    intent: "Let the remaining gallery photographs show the room and the plates at poster scale, cropped hard and overlapping, never in a tidy even grid."
  - id: hours_location
    priority: essential
    show: all
    intent: |
      Answer "are they open, and where".
      - The seven days exactly as given.
      - "Hartsdale, NY", and (914) 723-0010 as a tap-to-call link.
      - BOOK A TABLE and ORDER NOW.
      - Parking, from their FAQ: street parking on Hartsdale Avenue and the metered garage across the street.
      - No map: there is no embed and no coordinates.
  - id: faq
    priority: supporting
    show: all
    intent: "Clear the four real hesitations, answers as given: reservations via Resy or phone, vegetarian and gluten-free (corn tortillas are 100% gluten-free), parking, and large parties."
  - id: cta
    priority: supporting
    show: all
    intent: "Close on 'Turn your ordinary party into a Fiesta!': sweet sixteens to weddings and corporate gatherings, Half Tray serves 8–10, Full Tray serves 15–18. Links to catering.html."

avoid:
  - "Inventing descriptions, times or deals for Taco Tuesday, Wine Wednesday, Ladies Night Thursday or Gentlemen's Night Monday. They ship as names only."
  - "Using the old site's 'Alex R.', 'Samantha G.' or 'Mike D.' quotes. Only the five reviews in the content are real."
  - "Rendering the address as anything other than 'Hartsdale, NY'."
  - "Inventing an email address, social links or a newsletter signup. None are in the content."
  - "Adding prices to catering trays, happy hour items, desserts, cordials or hot drinks. None exist, and they are shown unpriced rather than guessed."
  - "Inventing perks, pay or job descriptions on the hiring page."
  - "Calling anything 'gourmet street food'. VEGA is a dining room and cocktail bar, not a stall."
  - "Sombreros, papel picado clip-art, cactus icons, serape stripes or Día de los Muertos skulls as decoration."
  - "Pastel tints of the purple, rounded pill buttons, drop-shadow cards, or a white page with one coral button."
  - "Coral text on purple panels, and white small text on coral."
  - "Using the logo or favicon files as gallery or hero photographs, or using the old site's press-badge images, which are not in the supplied URLs."
  - "Linking any nav item or the Order and Book actions back to vegamexican.com. Use Resy and Toast only."
  - "Putting all 202 items, or any catering category, on the homepage."
